en.t: The Visigoths under King Alaric I begin to pillage Rome
en.s: Alaric I (; Gothic: 𐌰𐌻𐌰𐍂𐌴𐌹𐌺𐍃, Alarīks lit.'ruler of all'; Latin: Alaricus; c. 370 – 411 AD) was the first king of the Visigoths, from 395 to 410. He rose to leadership of the Goths who came to occupy Moesia—territory acquired a couple of decades earlier by a combined force of Goths and Alans after the Battle of Adrianople.

zh.t: 阿拉里克一世率领西哥特人开始劫掠罗马
zh.s: 阿拉里克一世（哥特语：𐌰𐌻𐌰𐍂𐌴𐌹𐌺𐍃，Alarīks，字面意为“众人之王”；拉丁语：Alaricus；约公元370年—411年）是西哥特人的首位国王，于395年至410年在位。他成为哥特人的领袖；这些哥特人占据了默西亚地区。数十年前，哥特人与阿兰人联军在阿德里安堡战役后取得了该地区。

en.s: The sack of Rome on 24 August 410 AD was undertaken by the Visigoths led by their king, Alaric. At that time, Rome was no longer the administrative capital of the Western Roman Empire, having been replaced first by Mediolanum (now Milan) in 286 and then by Ravenna in 402. Nevertheless, the city of Rome retained a paramount position as "the eternal city" and a spiritual center of the Empire.

zh.s: 公元410年8月24日，西哥特人在国王阿拉里克率领下洗劫罗马。当时，罗马已不再是西罗马帝国的行政首都：286年首都先迁至米迪奥拉努姆（今米兰），402年又迁至拉文纳。尽管如此，罗马仍以“永恒之城”和帝国的精神中心保有重要地位。

en.s: The Siege of Głogów or Defense of Głogów (German: Schlacht bei Glogau, Polish: Obrona Głogowa) took place on 24 August 1109 at the Silesian town of Głogów, between the Kingdom of Poland and the Holy Roman Empire. The event, recorded by the chronicler Gallus Anonymus in his Gesta principum Polonorum, is one of the most well-known episodes of early Polish medieval history.

zh.s: 格沃古夫围城战又称格沃古夫保卫战（德语：Schlacht bei Glogau；波兰语：Obrona Głogowa），于1109年8月24日在西里西亚的格沃古夫镇发生，交战双方是波兰王国和神圣罗马帝国。这一事件由编年史家加卢斯·阿诺尼穆斯记载于《波兰王公事迹》，是波兰中世纪早期史上最著名的事件之一。

en.s: The Battle of Hundsfeld or Battle of Psie Pole was said to be fought on 24 August 1109 near the Silesian capital Wrocław between the Holy Roman Empire in aid of the claims of the exiled Piast duke Zbigniew against his ruling half-brother, Bolesław III Wrymouth of Poland. It was recorded by the medieval Polish chronicler Bishop Wincenty Kadłubek of Kraków in his Chronica seu originale regum et principum Poloniae several decades later.

zh.s: 据称，洪茨费尔德战役又称“犬野之战”，于1109年8月24日在西里西亚首府弗罗茨瓦夫附近发生。神圣罗马帝国支持被流放的皮雅斯特公爵兹比格涅夫争夺权位，与其在位的同父异母兄弟、波兰的博莱斯瓦夫三世·歪嘴对抗。数十年后，克拉科夫主教、波兰中世纪编年史家温琴蒂·卡德武贝克在《波兰诸王公编年史》中记载了这场战役。

en.s: Not to be confused with the Battle of Sandwich (1460). The Battle of Sandwich, also called the Battle of Dover took place on 24 August 1217 as part of the First Barons' War. A Plantagenet English fleet commanded by Hubert de Burgh attacked a Capetian French armada led by Eustace the Monk and Robert of Courtenay off Sandwich, Kent. The English captured the French flagship and most of the supply vessels, forcing the rest of the French fleet to return to Calais. The French fleet was attempting to bring supplies to Prince Louis, later King Louis VIII of France, whose French forces held London at that time.

zh.s: 1217年8月24日，第一次男爵战争期间，休伯特·德·伯格指挥的金雀花王朝英格兰舰队在肯特郡桑威奇附近袭击了由修士尤斯塔斯和罗伯特·德·库西率领的卡佩王朝法国舰队。英军俘获法国旗舰和大部分补给船，迫使其余法舰返回加莱。当时，法国舰队正试图向路易王子运送补给；后来他成为法国国王路易八世，其军队当时占领着伦敦。

en.s: The Battle of Blanchetaque was fought on 24 August 1346 between an English army under King Edward III and a French force commanded by Godemar du Fay. The battle was part of the Crécy campaign, which took place during the early stages of the Hundred Years' War.

zh.s: 1346年8月24日，爱德华三世国王率领的英格兰军队与戈德马尔·迪·法伊指挥的法国军队交战。这场战役是克雷西战役行动的一部分，属于百年战争初期。

en.s: The siege of Lindholmen (Danish: Belejringen af Lindholmen) was a siege of the former Danish castle of Lindholmen in Scania during the Danish-Hanseatic War of 1361 – 1370 between Sueco–Hanseatic and Danish forces. The siege ended in a Danish victory: the Hanseatic leader Bruno Warendorp was killed, and the siege was subsequently lifted.

en.s: The Battle of Motta was fought in late August 1412 when an invading army of Hungarians, Germans and Croats led by Pippo Spano and Voivode Miklós Marczali attacked the Venetian positions at Motta in Italy and suffered a heavy defeat. In 1409, during the 20-year Hungarian civil war between King Sigismund and the Neapolitan house of Anjou, the losing contender, Ladislaus of Naples, sold his "rights" on Dalmatia to the Venetian Republic for 100,000 ducats.

zh.s: 莫塔战役发生于1412年8月下旬。由菲波·斯帕诺和米克洛什·马尔察利总督率领的匈牙利、德国和克罗地亚联军入侵意大利，在莫塔袭击威尼斯军队阵地，结果遭到惨败。1409年，在国王西吉斯蒙德与那不勒斯安茹王朝之间持续20年的匈牙利内战中，失利一方的竞争者那不勒斯的拉迪斯劳斯以100,000达克特将其对达尔马提亚的“权利”卖给威尼斯共和国。

en.t: The oldest known version of the Gutenberg Bible, the first major book produced on a printing press, was completed
en.s: The Gutenberg Bible, also known as the 42-line Bible, the Mazarin Bible or the B42, is the earliest major book printed in Europe using mass-produced metal movable type. It marked the start of the "Gutenberg Revolution" and the age of printed books in the West. The book is valued and revered for its high aesthetic and artistic qualities and its historical significance.

zh.t: 已知最古老版本的古腾堡圣经完成印刷，这是首批由印刷机制作的重要书籍之一
zh.s: 古腾堡圣经又称42行圣经、马扎兰圣经或B42，是欧洲最早使用大批量生产的金属活字印刷的重要书籍。它标志着“古腾堡革命”和西方印刷书籍时代的开端。这本书因其高度的审美和艺术价值以及历史意义而备受珍视。

en.s: The Battle of Marj Dābiq (Arabic: مرج دابق‎‎, meaning "the meadow of Dābiq"; Turkish: Mercidabık Muharebesi) was a decisive military engagement in Middle Eastern history, fought on 24 August 1516, near the town of Dabiq, 44 km north of Aleppo, Syria. The battle was part of the 1516–17 war between the Ottoman Empire and the Mamluk Sultanate, which ended in an Ottoman victory and conquest of much of the Middle East, bringing about the destruction of the Mamluk Sultanate. The Ottoman victory in this battle gave Selim's armies control of the entire region of Syria and opened the door to the invasion of Egypt.

zh.s: 马尔吉·达比克战役（阿拉伯语：مرج دابق，意为“达比克草原”；土耳其语：Mercidabık Muharebesi）是中东历史上的一场重要战役，1516年8月24日发生在达比克镇附近，距叙利亚阿勒颇以北44公里。战役属于1516至1517年奥斯曼帝国与马穆鲁克苏丹国之间的战争，最终奥斯曼获胜并征服中东大部，马穆鲁克苏丹国也因此覆灭。塞利姆一世的军队在此战获胜后控制了整个叙利亚地区，并得以进军埃及。

en.s: The Battle of Haddon Rig was fought about three miles east of Kelso, in the Scottish Borders, between Scotland and England on 24 August 1542, during the reigns of King James V of Scotland and Henry VIII of England. The Scottish army was led by the George Gordon, 4th Earl of Huntly and the English army was led by Robert Bowes, Deputy Warden of the English East March.

zh.s: 1542年8月24日，苏格兰国王詹姆斯五世和英格兰国王亨利八世在位期间，苏格兰与英格兰军队在苏格兰边区凯尔索以东约3英里处的哈登里格交战。苏格兰军由亨特利伯爵乔治·戈登率领，英格兰军由英格兰东部边区副边境总督罗伯特·鲍斯率领。

en.s: The siege of Schoonhoven of 1575, also known as the capture of Schoonhoven, was a Spanish victory that took place between 11 and 24 August 1575, at Schoonhoven, Spanish Netherlands (present-day South Holland, the Netherlands), during the Eighty Years' War and the Anglo-Spanish War (1585–1604). On June 28, 1575, the Spanish forces, between 8,000 and 10,000 soldiers, led by Gilles de Berlaymont, Lord of Hierges, and Stadtholder of Guelders, Holland, Zeeland and Utrecht, captured Buren, and on August 7, Oudewater.

zh.s: 1575年斯洪霍芬围城战又称攻占斯洪霍芬，是西班牙取得的一场胜利，于1575年8月11日至24日在西属尼德兰的斯洪霍芬（今荷兰南荷兰省）发生，属于八十年战争和英西战争（1585—1604年）的一部分。1575年6月28日，吉尔·德·贝尔莱蒙率领8000至10000名西班牙士兵攻占布伦；8月7日又攻占奥德瓦特。贝尔莱蒙是耶尔日领主，并兼任海尔德兰、荷兰、泽兰和乌得勒支的执政官。

en.s: The siege of Aachen took place in 24 August 1614, when the Spanish Army of Flanders, led by Ambrogio Spinola, 1st Marquis of the Balbases, marched from Maastricht to Germany to support Wolfgang Wilhelm, Count Palatine of Neuburg, during the War of the Jülich Succession. Despite its status as a free imperial city, Aachen was under the protection of John Sigismund of Brandenburg, Neuburg's ally, and then rival, in the battle for the United Duchies of Jülich-Cleves-Berg.

zh.s: 1614年8月24日，尤利希继承战争期间，安布罗焦·斯皮诺拉率领佛兰德斯西班牙军从马斯特里赫特进军德国，支援诺伊堡伯爵、普法尔茨-诺伊堡公爵沃尔夫冈·威廉。尽管亚琛是自由帝国城市，却处于勃兰登堡的约翰·西吉斯蒙德保护之下；在争夺尤利希—克莱沃—贝格联合公国的战争中，约翰·西吉斯蒙德既是诺伊堡的盟友，后来也是其对手。

en.s: The Dutch expedition to Valdivia was a naval expedition, commanded by Hendrik Brouwer, sent by the Dutch Republic in 1643 to establish a base of operations and a trading post on the southern coast of Chile. With Spain and the Dutch Republic at war, the Dutch wished to take over the ruins of the abandoned Spanish city of Valdivia. The expedition sacked the Spanish settlements of Carelmapu and Castro in the Chiloé Archipelago before sailing to Valdivia, having the initial support of the local natives. The Dutch arrived in Valdivia on 24 August 1643 and named the colony Brouwershaven after Brouwer, who had died several weeks earlier.

zh.s: 1643年，荷兰共和国派遣亨德里克·布劳威尔率领海军远征队，前往智利南岸建立行动基地和贸易站。当时西班牙与荷兰处于战争状态，荷兰人希望占领已被西班牙人遗弃的瓦尔迪维亚城废墟。远征队先洗劫了奇洛埃群岛上的西班牙定居点卡雷尔马普和卡斯特罗，在当地原住民最初支持下继续驶向瓦尔迪维亚。荷兰人于1643年8月24日抵达瓦尔迪维亚，并以数周前去世的布劳威尔之名，将殖民地命名为布劳威尔港。

en.s: A Scottish invasion of England took place near Carlisle on 8 July 1648 as part of the Second English Civil War. The First English Civil War between Royalist supporters of Charles I and an alliance of Parliamentarian and Scottish forces had ended in 1646 with Charles defeated and imprisoned. He continued to negotiate with several factions among his opponents and this sparked the Second English Civil War in 1648.

en.t: The 1662 Book of Common Prayer was legally enforced as the liturgy of the Church of England, precipitating the Great Ejection of Dissenter ministers from their benefices
en.s: The 1662 Book of Common Prayer is an authorised liturgical book of the Church of England and other Anglican bodies around the world. en.s: Lochry's Defeat, also known as the Lochry massacre, was a battle fought on August 24, 1781, near present-day Aurora, Indiana, in the United States. The battle was part of the American Revolutionary War (1775–1783), which began as a conflict between Great Britain and the Thirteen Colonies before spreading to the western frontier, where American Indians entered the war as British allies.

zh.s: 1781年8月24日，洛克里的败战（又称洛克里大屠杀）在今美国印第安纳州奥罗拉附近发生。这场战斗是美国独立战争（1775—1783年）的一部分。战争最初由英国与北美十三殖民地交战，之后扩展至西部边疆，当地原住民以英国盟友身份参战。

en.s: The First Battle of Svensksund, also known as the First Battle of Rochensalm, was a naval battle fought in the Gulf of Finland in the Baltic Sea outside the present-day city of Kotka on 24 August 1789 during the Russo-Swedish War.

zh.s: 1789年8月24日，俄瑞战争期间，第一次斯文斯克松德海战又称第一次罗赫恩萨尔姆海战，在波罗的海芬兰湾、今科特卡市外海举行。

en.s: The bombardment of Tangier was a naval attack launched on August 24, 1791, by Spain against the Moroccan city of Tangier in response to the Moroccan sultan Moulay Yazid's declaration of war and siege of Ceuta. Following the failure of peace attempts between Spain and Morocco, Spanish King Charles IV also officially declared war on Morocco and ordered the bombardment of Tangier.

zh.s: 1791年8月24日，西班牙对摩洛哥城市丹吉尔发动海上攻击，以回应摩洛哥苏丹穆莱·亚齐德宣战并围攻休达。西班牙与摩洛哥的和谈努力失败后，西班牙国王卡洛斯四世也正式对摩洛哥宣战，并下令轰击丹吉尔。

en.s: The Battle of Friedberg was fought on 24 August 1796 between a First French Republic army led by Jean Victor Marie Moreau and a Habsburg Austrian army led by Maximilian Anton Karl, Count Baillet de Latour. The French army, which was advancing eastward on the south side of the Danube, managed to catch an isolated Austrian infantry regiment. In the ensuing combat, the Austrians were cut to pieces.

zh.t: 弗里德贝格战役（巴伐利亚）
zh.s: 1796年8月24日，莫罗率领的法兰西第一共和国军队与马克西米利安·安东·卡尔·贝耶·德·拉图尔伯爵指挥的哈布斯堡奥地利军队交战。法军沿多瑙河南岸向东推进，成功截住一支孤立的奥地利步兵团。随后的战斗中，奥军遭到重创。

en.s: The Battle of Amberg, fought on 24 August 1796, resulted in a Habsburg victory by Archduke Charles over a French army led by Jean-Baptiste Jourdan. This engagement marked a turning point in the Rhine campaign, which had previously seen French successes.

zh.s: 1796年8月24日，查理大公率领哈布斯堡军队击败让-巴蒂斯特·儒尔当指挥的法军，取得安贝格战役胜利。这场战斗成为莱茵战役的转折点；此前法军曾取得胜利。

en.s: The siege of Stralsund lasted from 24 July to 24 August, 1807, and saw troops from the First French Empire twice attempt to capture the port city from Lieutenant General Hans Henric von Essen's 15,000-man Swedish garrison. Early that year, Marshal Édouard Adolphe Casimir Joseph Mortier blockaded the city for two months before he was called elsewhere. In his absence, the Swedes drove back the inferior blockading force.

zh.t: 施特拉尔松德围城战（1807年）
zh.s: 1807年7月24日至8月24日，法兰西第一帝国军队两次试图从汉斯·亨里克·冯·埃森中将率领的1.5万名瑞典守军手中夺取港口城市施特拉尔松德。当年早些时候，爱德华·阿道夫·卡西米尔·约瑟夫·莫蒂埃元帅曾围城两个月，后被召往别处。他离开后，人数较少的瑞典军队击退了封锁部队。

en.s: The French army besieged the large Spanish naval base of Cádiz from 5 February 1810 to 24 August 1812 during the Peninsular War. Following the occupation of Seville, Cádiz became the Spanish seat of power, and was targeted by 70,000 French troops under the command of the Marshals Claude Victor and Jean-de-Dieu Soult for one of the most important sieges of the war.

zh.s: 半岛战争期间，法国军队于1810年2月5日至1812年8月24日围攻西班牙大型海军基地加的斯。塞维利亚被占领后，加的斯成为西班牙的权力中心。克洛德·维克托元帅和让-德迪厄·苏尔特元帅率领7万名法军围攻加的斯，这是战争中最重要的围城战之一。

en.s: The Battle of Bladensburg, also known as the Bladensburg Races, took place on August 24, 1814, during the Chesapeake campaign of the War of 1812 at Bladensburg, Maryland. It has been described as "the greatest disgrace ever dealt to American arms". A British force of army regulars and Royal Marines routed a combined U.S. force of Regular Army and state militia troops.

zh.s: 1814年8月24日，1812年战争的切萨皮克战役期间，布拉登斯堡战役（又称布拉登斯堡溃败）在马里兰州布拉登斯堡打响。这场战役被称为“美国军队遭受过的最大耻辱”。英国陆军正规部队和皇家海军陆战队击溃了由美国陆军正规部队和州民兵组成的联军。

en.s: The Burning of Washington, also known as the Capture of Washington, was a successful British amphibious attack conducted by Rear Admiral George Cockburn during Admiral John Warren's Chesapeake campaign. It was the only time since the American Revolutionary War that a foreign power had captured and occupied a United States capital. Following the defeat of American forces at the Battle of Bladensburg on August 24, 1814, a British army led by Major-General Robert Ross marched on Washington, D.C.

zh.s: 华盛顿焚城事件又称攻占华盛顿，是乔治·科伯恩海军少将率领的英军在约翰·沃伦海军上将的切萨皮克战役中发动的一次成功两栖进攻。自美国独立战争以来，这是外国势力首次攻占并占领美国首都。1814年8月24日，美军在布拉登斯堡战役中战败后，罗伯特·罗斯少将率英军向华盛顿特区进军。

en.s: The Constitution of the Kingdom of the Netherlands of 24 August 1815 (Dutch: Grondwet voor het Koninkrijk der Nederlanden van 24 augustus 1815) is one of two fundamental documents governing the Kingdom of the Netherlands as well as the fundamental law of the Netherlands proper (the territory of the Kingdom mainly situated in Europe).

zh.s: 《1815年8月24日荷兰王国宪法》（荷兰语：Grondwet voor het Koninkrijk der Nederlanden van 24 augustus 1815）是治理荷兰王国的两份根本文件之一，也是荷兰本土（王国主要位于欧洲的领土）的根本法律。

Despite the name, the treaty was conducted at Portage des Sioux, Missouri, located immediately north of St.

zh.s: 1816年《圣路易斯条约》由尼尼安·爱德华兹、威廉·克拉克、奥古斯特·肖托代表美国，与三火联盟（渥太华族、奥杰布瓦族和波塔瓦托米族）的代表签署。条约于1816年8月24日签署，并于同年12月30日正式公布。尽管名为《圣路易斯条约》，签署地点实际在密苏里州波蒂奇德苏，位于圣路易斯以北。

en.s: The Treaty of Córdoba established Mexican independence from Spain at the conclusion of the Mexican War of Independence. It was signed on August 24, 1821 in Córdoba, Veracruz, Mexico. The signatories were the head of the Army of the Three Guarantees, Agustín de Iturbide, and, acting on behalf of the Spanish government, Jefe Político Superior Juan O'Donojú. The treaty has 17 articles, which developed the proposals of the Plan of Iguala. The Treaty is the first document in which Spanish and Mexican officials accept the liberty of what will become the First Mexican Empire, but it is not today recognized as the foundational moment, since these ideas are often attributed to the Grito de Dolores (September 16, 1810).

zh.s: 墨西哥独立战争结束时签署的《科尔多瓦条约》确立了墨西哥脱离西班牙独立。条约于1821年8月24日在墨西哥韦拉克鲁斯州科尔多瓦签署，签署者为三保证军总司令阿古斯丁·德·伊图尔维德，以及代表西班牙政府的高级政治长官胡安·奥多诺胡。条约共17条，进一步阐述了《伊瓜拉计划》的主张。这是西班牙和墨西哥官员首次在文件中承认未来第一墨西哥帝国的自由；不过，如今通常认为墨西哥独立的起点是1810年9月16日的多洛雷斯呼声。

en.t: Battle of Villar de los Navarros
en.s: The Battle of Villar de los Navarros (August 24, 1837) was a battle of the First Carlist War. It occurred near the town of Villar de los Navarros in Zaragoza Province and was a victory for the Carlists. The Carlists took many prisoners, including the brigadier Ramón Solano, 84 officers, 60 sergeants, and 1,500 infantrymen; 400 of whom were forced to join the Carlist army. 1,245 prisoners, many badly wounded, were taken on the night of August 24 to the towns of Herrera de los Navarros and Villar de los Navarros.

zh.t: 比利亚尔-德洛斯-纳瓦罗斯战役
zh.s: 比利亚尔-德洛斯-纳瓦罗斯战役于1837年8月24日爆发，是第一次卡洛斯战争中的一场战斗。战场位于萨拉戈萨省比利亚尔-德洛斯-纳瓦罗斯镇附近，卡洛斯派获胜。卡洛斯派俘虏了许多人，包括准将拉蒙·索拉诺、84名军官、60名军士和1500名步兵，其中400人被迫加入卡洛斯派军队。8月24日晚，1245名俘虏（其中许多人身负重伤）被押往埃雷拉-德洛斯-纳瓦罗斯镇和比利亚尔-德洛斯-纳瓦罗斯镇。

en.s: The Battle of Fajslawice, one of many clashes of the January Uprising, took place on August 24, 1863, near the village of Fajslawice, which at that time belonged to Russian-controlled Congress Poland. A party of 1,500 Polish insurgents, commanded by Michał Heydenreich, clashed with 2,500 soldiers of the Imperial Russian Army’s Mounted Artillery Division under Colonel Grigoriy Emanov. The battle, which was one of the bloodiest clashes of the uprising, resulted in Russian victory. The insurgents lost 320 killed, 650 captured and 40 wounded, while Russian losses were app. 40 wounded and unknown number killed.

zh.s: 1863年8月24日，一月起义期间的法伊斯瓦维采战役在该村附近爆发。当时法伊斯瓦维采属于俄罗斯控制的波兰王国。米哈乌·海登赖希率领1500名波兰起义军，与格里戈里·叶马诺夫上校指挥的2500名俄罗斯帝国骑炮兵师士兵交战。这是一月起义中伤亡最惨重的战斗之一，俄军获胜。起义军有320人阵亡、650人被俘、40人受伤；俄军约40人受伤，死亡人数不明。

en.s: The action at Ashley's Station was fought between Confederate cavalry under Brigadier-General Joseph O. Shelby and the Union Army garrison under the command of Brigadier-General Christopher Andrews and Colonels Greenville M. Mitchell and Washington F. Geiger in Prairie County, Arkansas on August 24, 1864 during the American Civil War.

zh.s: 1864年8月24日，美国内战期间，约瑟夫·O·谢尔比准将率领的邦联骑兵与联邦军守军在阿肯色州普雷里县交战。联邦军由克里斯托弗·安德鲁斯准将以及格林维尔·M·米切尔和华盛顿·F·盖格两名上校指挥。

en.s: Goodison Park is a football stadium in Walton, Liverpool, England, two miles (3 km) north of the city centre. It was built to serve as the home ground of Everton and opened in 1892. Goodison Park hosted the 1910 FA Cup Final, and was also a venue for the 1966 World Cup, in addition to hosting numerous other international fixtures.

zh.s: 古迪逊公园是一座足球场，位于英格兰利物浦的沃尔顿，距离市中心以北两英里（3公里）。球场建成后成为埃弗顿足球俱乐部的主场，于1892年开放。古迪逊公园还曾承办1910年足总杯决赛和1966年世界杯比赛，以及多场其他国际赛事。

en.s: The 1902 Tie Cup final was the final match to decide the winner of the Tie Cup, the 3rd edition of the international competition organised by the Argentine and Uruguayan Associations together. The final was contested by the two same teams of the previous edition, Argentine sides Alumni and Rosario A.C., from Buenos Aires and Rosario respectively.

zh.s: 1902年Tie Cup决赛是决定该赛事冠军的最后一场比赛，也是阿根廷和乌拉圭协会联合组织的这项国际赛事的第3届。决赛双方与上一届相同，都是阿根廷球队：来自布宜诺斯艾利斯的Alumni和来自罗萨里奥的罗萨里奥体育俱乐部。

en.s: The Bury St Edmunds by-election of 1907 was held on 24 August 1907. The by-election was held due to the succession to the peerage of the incumbent Conservative MP, Frederick Hervey who become the Fourth Marquess of Bristol. It was won by the Conservative candidate Walter Guinness.

zh.s: 1907年8月24日举行圣埃德蒙兹伯里补选。时任保守党议员弗雷德里克·赫维继承贵族爵位、成为第四代布里斯托尔侯爵后，议席出现空缺。保守党候选人沃尔特·吉尼斯赢得补选。

en.s: A by-election was held for the Australian House of Representatives seat of Kooyong on 24 August 1910. This was triggered by the resignation of Commonwealth Liberal Party (CLP) MP William Knox. The election was won by CLP candidate Sir Robert Best.

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Portugal on 24 August 1911. Following the Portuguese revolution in 1910 which saw the overthrow of King Manuel II, a Republican Provisional Government was formed under the leadership of Teófilo Braga. This election was held to elect the first official president of the newly established the First Portuguese Republic. Portugal's 1911 constitution stated that the Congress of the Republic must elect the president in Lisbon instead of the Portuguese people.

zh.s: 1911年8月24日，葡萄牙举行总统选举。1910年葡萄牙革命推翻曼努埃尔二世国王后，特奥菲洛·布拉加领导成立了共和临时政府。这次选举旨在选出新成立的葡萄牙第一共和国首任正式总统。根据葡萄牙1911年宪法，总统由共和国国会在里斯本选出，而不是由葡萄牙选民直接选举。

en.s: The Maziua raid was an armed clash between German and Portuguese colonial troops in Mozambique on 24 August 1914 during World War I. Though the two countries were officially at peace, German soldiers carried out a cross-border raid into Portuguese Mozambique for unclear reasons, and destroyed the outpost of Maziua. The Portuguese soldiers killed in the raid were the first Portuguese casualties of World War I.

zh.s: 第一次世界大战期间，1914年8月24日，德国和葡萄牙殖民军在莫桑比克发生武装冲突。两国当时名义上处于和平状态，但德国士兵出于不明原因越境突袭葡属莫桑比克，摧毁了马齐乌阿哨所。此次突袭中阵亡的葡萄牙士兵是葡萄牙在一战中的首批伤亡人员。

en.s: The action of Elouges on 24 August 1914 was fought during the First World War. Following the Battle of Mons the British Expeditionary Force was withdrawing, closely followed by the advancing German Army. The British 5th Division was assisted by the 2nd Cavalry Brigade and 3rd Cavalry Brigade. During the action the 4th (Royal Irish) Dragoon Guards and 'A' Squadron, the 9th (Queen's Royal) Lancers charged the German guns.

zh.s: 1914年8月24日，第一次世界大战期间，埃卢日战斗打响。蒙斯战役后，英国远征军正在撤退，德军紧追其后。英国第5师得到第2和第3骑兵旅支援。战斗中，皇家爱尔兰第4龙骑兵卫队和皇家女王枪骑兵团第9团“A”中队冲锋攻击德军炮兵。

en.s: The Battle of Cer was a military campaign fought between Austria-Hungary and Serbia in August 1914, starting three weeks into the Serbian Campaign of 1914, the initial military action of the First World War. It took place around Cer Mountain and several surrounding villages, as well as the town of Šabac.
en.n: World War I: The Battle of Cer ends as the first Allied victory in the war.

zh.n: 第一次世界大战：塞尔战役结束，协约国取得战争爆发以来的首次胜利。

The French Fifth Army and the British Expeditionary Force (BEF) advanced into Belgium and fought the Battle of Charleroi (21–23 August) and Battle of Mons (23 August), from the Meuse crossings in the east, to Mons in the west.

en.s: The Battle of Mlali was fought during the East African Campaign of World War I. In mid-August 1916, the British, led by General Jan Christiaan Smuts, advanced three divisions from Kenya south into the Imperial German colony of Tanganyika to seize and disrupt their vital railway. Informed of the British movement by his scouts, the German commander Paul von Lettow-Vorbeck sent Captain Otto to investigate.

zh.s: 姆拉利战役发生于第一次世界大战东非战役期间。1916年8月中旬，扬·克里斯蒂安·史末资将军率领英军三个师从肯尼亚向南进入德属东非殖民地坦噶尼喀，意图夺取并破坏当地重要铁路。德国指挥官保罗·冯·莱托-福尔贝克从侦察兵处获知英军动向后，派遣奥托上尉前去调查。

en.s: The Caerphilly by-election of 1921 was held on 24 August 1921. The by-election was held due to the death of the incumbent Labour MP, Alfred Onions. It was won by the Labour candidate Morgan Jones. Morgan Jones clinched the Labour nomination despite not being the preferred candidate of the South Wales Miners' Federation. He was the first conscientious objector to be elected to Parliament after World War I.

zh.s: 1921年8月24日举行凯尔菲利补选。时任工党议员阿尔弗雷德·奥尼恩斯去世后，该席位出现空缺。工党候选人摩根·琼斯赢得补选。尽管南威尔士矿工联合会更支持其他人，琼斯仍获得工党提名。他是一战后首位当选议员的良心拒服兵役者。

en.s: Sixty-seven or sixty-nine Jews were massacred on 24 August 1929 in Hebron, Mandatory Palestine. The event also left scores seriously wounded or maimed. Jewish homes were pillaged and synagogues were ransacked. The massacre was perpetrated by Arabs incited to violence by rumors that Jews were planning to seize control of the Temple Mount in Jerusalem.

zh.s: 1929年8月24日，英属巴勒斯坦托管地希伯伦有67名或69名犹太人遭屠杀。另有数十人重伤或致残。犹太人住宅遭到洗劫，会堂被劫掠。阿拉伯人受到谣言煽动而施暴，谣言称犹太人计划控制耶路撒冷圣殿山。

en.s: The 1931 Quebec general election was held on August 24, 1931, to elect members of the Legislative Assembly of the Province of Quebec, Canada. The incumbent Quebec Liberal Party, led by Louis-Alexandre Taschereau, was re-elected, defeating the Quebec Conservative Party, led by Camillien Houde. It was the third general election victory in a row for Taschereau, who had held office since 1920.

zh.s: 1931年8月24日，加拿大魁北克省举行大选，选出省议会议员。由路易-亚历山大·塔谢罗领导的魁北克自由党成功连任，击败由卡米利安·乌德领导的魁北克保守党。这是自1920年执政以来，塔谢罗连续第三次赢得大选。

en.s: The 1933 Victorian local elections were held on 24 August 1933 to elect the councils of 70 of the local government areas in Victoria, Australia. One council also held a referendum. The Age observed that there were an "unusually large" amount of candidates elected unopposed − 77 in the metropolitan Melbourne area and a further 450 in regional Victoria.

en.s: The Santoña Agreement or Pact of Santoña was an agreement signed in the town of Guriezo, near Santoña, Cantabria, on August 24, 1937, during the Spanish Civil War, between politicians close to the Basque Nationalist Party (Partido Nacionalista Vasco or PNV), fighting with the Republican Side, and Italian forces fighting with the Francoist side. During the Battle of Santander, the Francoist troops pierced through the Republican defense lines.

zh.s: 西班牙内战期间，1937年8月24日，巴斯克民族主义党（Partido Nacionalista Vasco，简称PNV）阵营的政治人物与站在佛朗哥一方的意大利军队在坎塔布里亚桑托尼亚附近的古里埃索镇签署桑托尼亚协定。在桑坦德战役期间，佛朗哥派军队突破了共和派防线。

en.s: The Zaragoza Offensive took place during the Spanish Civil War in 1937. This battle involved the Spanish Republican Army. The main goal of the offensive was to occupy the city of Zaragoza. The main action of the offensive was the battle of Belchite.

en.t: Spanish Civil War: Sovereign Council of Asturias and León is proclaimed in Gijón
en.s: The Sovereign Council of Asturias and León (Spanish: Consejo Soberano de Asturias y León, Asturian: Conseyu Soberanu d'Asturies y Llión), was an unrecognized state in northern Spain during the Spanish Civil War. Proclaimed on 6 September 1936, it was self-declared sovereign on 24 August 1937, while the region was occupied on 20 October 1937 by Franco's military forces. Belarmino Tomás was the Sovereign Council's first and only President.

zh.t: 西班牙内战：阿斯图里亚斯和莱昂主权委员会在希洪宣告成立
zh.s: 阿斯图里亚斯和莱昂主权委员会（西班牙语：Consejo Soberano de Asturias y León；阿斯图里亚斯语：Conseyu Soberanu d'Asturies y Llión）是西班牙内战期间西班牙北部一个未获承认的政权。该委员会于1936年9月6日成立，并于1937年8月24日自行宣布拥有主权。佛朗哥军队于1937年10月20日占领该地区。贝拉尔米诺·托马斯是委员会首任也是唯一一任主席。

en.s: The Battle of Belchite refers to a series of military operations that took place between 24 August and 7 September 1937, in and around the town of Belchite (almost 4,000 inhabitants in 1936, decreasing to around 2,600 during the battle, from the repression and displacement of the first year), in Aragon during the Spanish Civil War, as part of a much bigger offensive to take Zaragoza, that continued until the beginning of November 1937.

en.s: The Kweilin incident occurred on 24 August 1938 when a Douglas DC-2 airliner named Kweilin carrying 18 passengers and crew was shot down by Japanese aircraft in China. There were fifteen fatalities including two crew. It was the first civilian airliner in history to be shot down by hostile aircraft. The pilot of the downed aircraft was American and the crew and passengers Chinese.

zh.s: 1938年8月24日，一架名为“桂林号”、载有18名乘客和机组人员的道格拉斯DC-2客机在中国被日本飞机击落。事件造成15人死亡，其中包括两名机组人员。这是历史上首架被敌方飞机击落的民航客机。被击落飞机的飞行员是美国人，机组人员和乘客则是中国人。

en.s: The naval Battle of the Eastern Solomons (also known as the Battle of the Stewart Islands and, in Japanese sources, as the Second Battle of the Solomon Sea (第二次ソロモン海戦)) took place on 24–25 August 1942, and was the third carrier battle of the Pacific campaign of World War II and the second major engagement fought between the United States Navy and the Imperial Japanese Navy during the Guadalcanal Campaign. As at the Battle of the Coral Sea and the Battle of Midway, the ships of the two adversaries were never within sight of each other.

zh.s: 东所罗门群岛海战又称斯图尔特群岛海战，日本资料称第二次所罗门海海战（第二次ソロモン海戦），于1942年8月24日至25日举行。这是第二次世界大战太平洋战场的第三场航母海战，也是瓜达尔卡纳尔战役期间美国海军与日本帝国海军之间的第二次重大交战。与珊瑚海海战和中途岛海战一样，交战双方的舰船始终没有进入彼此视野。

en.s: The Charge of the "Savoia Cavalleria" at Izbushensky was a clash between the Italian cavalry Regiment "Savoia Cavalleria" (3rd) and the Soviet 812th Rifle Regiment (304th Rifle Division) that took place on 24 August 1942, near the hamlet (khutor) of Izbushensky (Избушенский), close to the junction between the Don and Khopyor rivers.

en.s: Operation Banquet was a British operation of the Royal Navy in the Second World War, commanded by Rear Admiral Clement Moody. The objective was to bomb Japanese positions in and around Padang, on the south-western coast of Sumatra, in Indonesia, on 24 August 1944. The targets of the attack, Padang airfield, the Indaroeng cement works, and the harbor facilities and shipping at Emmahaven were also hit.

zh.s: 第二次世界大战期间，英国皇家海军在克莱门特·穆迪海军少将指挥下实施“宴会行动”。1944年8月24日，行动目标是轰炸印度尼西亚苏门答腊岛西南海岸巴东及周边的日军阵地。巴东机场、英达隆水泥厂，以及埃玛港的港口设施和船只也遭到袭击。

en.s: The battle of Wuhe (五河战斗) took place in the Five Rivers (Wuhe, 五河) region of eastern Anhui and was a clash between the communists and the former nationalists turned Japanese puppet regime force who rejoined the nationalists after World War II. The battle was one of the Chinese Civil War in the immediate post World War II era.

en.s: The 1947 Svenska Cupen final took place on 24 August 1947 at Råsunda in Solna. It was contested between Allsvenskan sides Malmö FF and AIK. AIK played their first final since 1943 and their second final in total, Malmö FF played their fourth consecutive final and their fourth final in total. Malmö FF won their third title with a 3–2 victory.

zh.s: 1947年8月24日，瑞典杯决赛在索尔纳的拉松达球场举行，由瑞典超级联赛球队马尔默FF对阵AIK。AIK自1943年以来首次进入决赛，这是该队第二次闯入决赛；马尔默FF则连续第四年进入决赛，也是队史第四次。马尔默FF以3比2获胜，第三次夺冠。

en.s: United Air Lines Flight 615 was a US transcontinental east–west airline service from Boston to Hartford, Cleveland, Chicago, Oakland and San Francisco. On August 24, 1951, the Douglas DC-6 with registration N37550 operating the service, crashed on approach to Oakland, causing the death of all 44 passengers and 6 crew members on board. The flight departed Chicago at 10:59 p.m. CST en route to Oakland.

zh.s: 联合航空615号航班是美国一条横贯东西的航线，途经波士顿、哈特福德、克利夫兰、芝加哥、奥克兰和旧金山。1951年8月24日，执飞该航班、注册号为N37550的道格拉斯DC-6客机在飞往奥克兰途中进近时坠毁，机上44名乘客和6名机组人员全部遇难。飞机于中部标准时间晚上10时59分从芝加哥起飞，飞往奥克兰。

en.s: The Communist Control Act of 1954 (68 Stat. 775, 50 U.S.C. §§ 841–844) is an American law signed by President Dwight Eisenhower on August 24, 1954, that outlawed the Communist Party USA and criminalized membership in or support for the party or "Communist-action organizations", on the basis that communists allegedly vowed to overthrow the government of the United States.

en.t: 10th National Congress of the Chinese Communist Party
en.s: The 10th National Congress of the Chinese Communist Party was held in the Great Hall of the People, Beijing, between August 24 and 28, 1973. 1,249 delegates represented the party's estimated 28 million members. en.s: Hurricane Andrew was a compact but extremely powerful tropical cyclone that became the most destructive hurricane to ever hit Florida in terms of structures damaged or destroyed and remained the costliest in financial terms until Hurricane Irma surpassed it 25 years later. Andrew was also the strongest hurricane to make landfall in the United States in decades and the costliest hurricane to strike anywhere in the country, until it was surpassed by Hurricane Katrina in 2005.
en.n: Hurricane Andrew makes landfall in Homestead, Florida as a Category 5 hurricane, causing up to $25 billion (1992 USD) in damages.

zh.s: 飓风安德鲁是一个体型较小但威力极强的热带气旋。按建筑受损或被毁的数量计算，它是袭击佛罗里达州破坏性最大的飓风；按经济损失计算，它的损失金额最高，这一纪录25年后被飓风艾尔玛超过。数十年来，安德鲁也是登陆美国的最强飓风，并且是袭击美国造成经济损失最大的飓风，直到2005年被飓风卡特里娜超过。
zh.n: 飓风安德鲁以五级飓风强度在佛罗里达州霍姆斯特德登陆，造成最高达250亿美元（1992年美元）的损失。

en.s: Microsoft Corporation is an American multinational technology company headquartered in Redmond, Washington. en.s: SummerSlam (2003) was a professional wrestling pay-per-view event produced by World Wrestling Entertainment (WWE) and presented by Stacker 2's YJ Stinger. It took place on August 24, 2003, at the America West Arena in Phoenix, Arizona. It was the 16th annual SummerSlam event and starred wrestlers from the Raw and SmackDown! brands. Nine professional wrestling matches were set on the event's supercard, a scheduling of multiple high-level matches. The first main event was an Elimination Chamber match, in which World Heavyweight Champion Triple H defeated Chris Jericho, Goldberg, Kevin Nash, Randy Orton, and Shawn Michaels to retain his championship.

en.s: On the night of 24 August 2004, explosive devices were detonated on board two domestic passenger flights that had taken off from Domodedovo International Airport in Moscow, Russia, causing the destruction of both aircraft and the death of all 90 people on board. Subsequent investigations concluded that two Chechen female suicide bombers were responsible for the bombings, which were also later claimed by the leader of the Chechen insurgency.

en.s: On August 24, 2008, an Aéreo Ruta Maya Cessna Caravan 208 carrying 10 American aid workers, two Guatemalan aid agency representatives, pilot and copilot en route from La Aurora International Airport, Guatemala City to El Estor, crashed 45 minutes after take off. The crash killed all occupants but three aid workers. The source of the crash was engine failure, as was called in by the pilot, who attempted to make an emergency landing according to the Guatemalan civil aviation director Jose Carlos. The aid workers were members of Choice Humanitarian, a West Jordan, Utah based humanitarian group on their way to the village of Sepamac.

en.s: The 2008 Supercoppa Italiana was a football match that was played by 2007–08 Serie A winners Inter Milan and 2007–08 Coppa Italia winners Roma. The match proved to be a tightly contested affair. After exchanging goals, it appeared that Inter Milan was on its way to victory on Mario Balotelli's goal on the 83rd minute, however, Mirko Vučinić tied the game for Roma at the 90th minute. Extra time settled nothing. In the penalty shoot-out, it appeared that a miss by Inter Milan's Dejan Stanković would be decisive, however, Roma captain Francesco Totti missed the team's fifth shot, which would have given his team the cup. In the seventh round, Roma's Juan missed while Inter Milan captain Javier Zanetti scored, ending the match in favour of the Serie A champions. The match took place on 24 August 2008 in San Siro, Milan.

zh.s: 2007—08赛季意甲冠军国际米兰与意大利杯冠军罗马在2008年意大利超级杯中交手。双方比分交替上升，马里奥·巴洛特利在第83分钟进球后，国际米兰一度看似将获胜，但米尔科·武齐尼奇在第90分钟为罗马扳平。加时赛未能分出胜负。点球大战中，国际米兰的德扬·斯坦科维奇罚失一球，罗马队长弗朗切斯科·托蒂也罚失了本可帮助球队夺冠的第五球。第七轮，罗马的胡安罚失，国际米兰队长哈维尔·萨内蒂罚中，意甲冠军国际米兰获胜。比赛于2008年8月24日在米兰圣西罗球场举行。

en.s: The Battle of Derapet was fought near the village of Derapet in the Tangi Valley in Deh Rahwod, Orūzgān Province, southern Afghanistan, between a combined Australian Army and Afghan National Army patrol and Taliban forces on 24 August 2010. Australian forces had only recently taken over responsibility for Deh Rahwod as part of a major expansion of their area of operations which took place following the Dutch withdrawal from Afghanistan in August. en.s: The 2010 San Fernando massacre, also known as the first massacre of San Fernando, was the mass murder of 72 undocumented immigrants by Los Zetas drug cartel in the village of El Huizachal in the municipality of San Fernando, Tamaulipas, Mexico. The 72 killed—58 men and 14 women—were mainly from Central and South America, and they were shot in the back of the head and then piled up together. The bodies were found inside a ranch on 24 August 2010 by the Mexican military after they engaged in an armed confrontation with members of a drug cartel.

zh.s: 2010年圣费尔南多大屠杀又称第一次圣费尔南多大屠杀，是泽塔斯贩毒集团在墨西哥塔毛利帕斯州圣费尔南多市埃尔维萨查尔村杀害72名无证移民的事件。遇难者中有58名男性和14名女性，主要来自中美洲和南美洲。他们都被从后脑开枪击毙，尸体堆在一起。2010年8月24日，墨西哥军方与贩毒集团成员发生武装冲突后，在一处牧场发现了这些尸体。

en.s: Agni Air Flight 101 was a regional flight between Kathmandu and Lukla, Nepal, that crashed on 24 August 2010, killing all 14 people on board. en.t: On August 24, 2010, Henan Airlines Flight 8387 crashed shortly before landing at Yichun Lindu Airport
en.s: Henan Airlines (Chinese: 河南航空; pinyin: Hénán Hángkōng), formerly Kunpeng Airlines (Chinese: 鲲鹏航空公司; pinyin: Kūnpéng Hángkōng Gōngsī), was a charter airline based in northern China. The airline was founded as a joint venture between Shenzhen Airlines and Mesa Air Group and was also the largest sino-foreign regional airline in China. In 2009 Mesa Air Group and Shenzhen terminated their agreement and Shenzhen announced that the airline would be renamed Henan Airlines.

zh.t: 2010年8月24日，河南航空8387号班机在即将降落伊春林都机场前坠毁
zh.s: 河南航空（中文：河南航空；拼音：Hénán Hángkōng）前身为鲲鹏航空（中文：鲲鹏航空公司；拼音：Kūnpéng Hángkōng Gōngsī），是一家总部位于中国北方的包机航空公司。该公司由深圳航空与Mesa Air Group合资创立，也是中国最大的中外合资支线航空公司。2009年，Mesa Air Group与深圳航空终止协议，深圳航空随后宣布将该公司更名为河南航空。

en.s: A by-election was held in the Nui constituency in Tuvalu on 24 August 2011. It was triggered by the death of the incumbent, MP Isaia Italeli, the Minister for Works, who died quite suddenly in late July while in Samoa on government business. Although there are no political parties in Tuvalu, Members of Parliament align themselves with the government or with the Opposition, and Italeli's death had resulted in Prime Minister Willy Telavi's government losing its one-seat majority in Parliament. The by-election was thus highly important to the government's survival.

zh.s: 2011年8月24日，图瓦卢努伊选区举行补选。补选由该选区时任议员、工程部长伊赛亚·伊塔莱利去世引发；他于7月下旬在萨摩亚执行公务期间突然离世。图瓦卢没有政党，但议员会支持政府或反对派。伊塔莱利去世后，威利·特拉维政府失去了在议会中的一席多数，因此这次补选对政府能否继续执政十分重要。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in the Republic of Abkhazia on 24 August 2014. The sixth such elections since the post of President of Abkhazia was created in 1994, they were held early due to the resignation of President Alexander Ankvab on 1 June 2014 following the 2014 Abkhazian political crisis. Four candidates contested the elections, which were won by Raul Khadjimba, who received just over 50% of the vote.

zh.s: 2014年8月24日，阿布哈兹共和国举行总统选举。这是1994年设立总统职位以来的第六次总统选举。2014年阿布哈兹政治危机后，亚历山大·安克瓦布总统于6月1日辞职，因此选举提前举行。共有4名候选人参选，劳尔·哈吉姆巴以略高于50%的得票率获胜。

en.t: A magnitude 6.0 earthquake strikes the San Francisco Bay Area; it is the largest in that area since 1989
en.s: The San Francisco Bay Area is the cultural and economic center of Northern California. The region surrounds and includes San Francisco Bay, and is anchored by the cities of Oakland, San Francisco, and San Jose. It is commonly known as the Bay Area or simply the Bay. With a population of over nine million people, the Bay Area is the second-largest combined statistical area in California and the fifth-largest in the United States.

en.s: Operation Euphrates Shield (Turkish: Fırat Kalkanı Harekâtı) was an offensive by the Turkish Armed Forces and the Turkish-backed Free Syrian Army, which led to the Turkish occupation of northern Syria. Operations were carried out in the region between the Euphrates river to the east and the rebel-held area around Azaz to the west. The Turkish military and Turkey-aligned Syrian rebel groups, some of which used the Free Syrian Army label, fought against the forces of the Islamic State (IS) as well as against the Syrian Democratic Forces (SDF) from 24 August 2016.

zh.s: “幼发拉底之盾行动”（土耳其语：Fırat Kalkanı Harekâtı）是土耳其武装部队和土耳其支持的叙利亚自由军发动的一次进攻，最终使土耳其占领叙利亚北部。行动在东面的幼发拉底河与西面的反政府武装控制区阿扎兹周边之间展开。自2016年8月24日起，土耳其军队及亲土耳其的叙利亚反政府武装（其中一些使用叙利亚自由军名号）与伊斯兰国（IS）和叙利亚民主力量（SDF）交战。

en.s: An earthquake, measuring 6.2 ± 0.016 on the moment magnitude scale, hit Central Italy on 24 August 2016 at 03:36:32 CEST (01:36 UTC). Its epicentre was close to Accumoli, with its hypocentre at a depth of 4 ± 1 km, approximately 75 km (47 mi) southeast of Perugia and 45 km (28 mi) north of L'Aquila, in an area near the borders of the Umbria, Lazio, Abruzzo and Marche regions.

zh.s: 2016年8月24日欧洲中部夏令时间3时36分32秒（UTC 1时36分），意大利中部发生地震，矩震级为6.2±0.016级。震中靠近阿库莫利，震源深度为4±1公里，位于佩鲁贾东南约75公里（47英里）、拉奎拉以北约45公里（28英里），靠近翁布里亚、拉齐奥、阿布鲁佐和马尔凯大区交界处。

en.t: Proxima Centauri b, the closest exoplanet to Earth, is discovered by the European Southern Observatory
en.s: Proxima Centauri b is an exoplanet orbiting within the habitable zone of the red dwarf star Proxima Centauri in the constellation Centaurus. It can also be referred to as Proxima b, or Alpha Centauri Cb. The host star is the closest star to the Sun, at a distance of about 4.2 light-years (1.3 parsecs) from Earth, and is part of the larger triple star system Alpha Centauri.

zh.t: 欧洲南方天文台发现比邻星b——距地球最近的系外行星
zh.s: 比邻星b是一颗系外行星，位于半人马座红矮星比邻星的宜居带内，也称为Proxima b或Alpha Centauri Cb。比邻星是距离太阳最近的恒星，距地球约4.2光年（1.3秒差距），并属于半人马座阿尔法三星系统。

en.t: Erin O'Toole is elected leader of the Conservative Party of Canada
en.s: Erin Michael O'Toole (born January 22, 1973) is a Canadian lawyer, former military officer and politician who was the leader of the Conservative Party of Canada and the leader of the Official Opposition from 2020 to 2022.
